messages:
Ally T: hey all, Ally here — first day in CS! quick: who to ping for HubSpot, Aircall, playbooks, and the short objection cheat? also curious about call recording defaults. :wave:
Rosa (IT): welcome Ally! I can send HubSpot and Aircall invites. HubSpot uses Okta MFA. Expect emails from hubspot-invite@redwood and aircall@notifications.
Ben (sales-ops): hi Ally :tada: canonical playbook is /playbooks/cs/cs_funnel_v7_master. Objection cheat called 'OBJECTION_BRIEF_CS_v4' in /playbooks/cs/cheatsheets. I'll drop links after you're in HubSpot.
Marta (CS): added you to Gong and the call-library. Recordings are ON by default for training. If you need recordings disabled for a specific customer, follow the rec-off steps in the handoff checklist and loop compliance.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Complete "Sales/CS Tools" checklist within 48 hours: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs.
Ally T: thanks! got HubSpot invite and set MFA. Aircall pending. also: is there a quick 1-pager for first-week cadence?
Ben (sales-ops): yes — "First Week CS Cadence" in the playbooks root. I'll share a calendar pack with listening assignments and a buddy pairing.
Rosa (IT): resent Aircall invite. If it lands in spam, reply here and I'll escalate. If you see a device error, tell me OS/browser.
Ally T: Aircall arrived, on web for now. one last Q: where are the outbound call scripts (Aircall macros)?
Marta (CS): macros live in Notion under `cs_templates_v3`. Use the 'cs-templates' Aircall script to auto-log HubSpot activities. Ping me for a 30-min walkthrough after tools are up.
Ally T: perfect — appreciate the speedy help everyone :raised_hands:
